gui.dmzrevamp.character_stats.spd.desc: Increases your Movement and Attack Speed while also lowering dash and attacks cooldown.
gui.dmzrevamp.prestige.confirmation.warn: You are about to Prestige. Once you do that, you'll gain a permanent increase in your scales and TP on top of increasing your max level, but you will also return to level 1, lose all your TP, all your skills (except Ki and Strike) and your transformations while the difficulty of Story Mode will increase too. Do you accept this?
gui.dmzrevamp.character_stats.speed.tool: The Speed of your attacks, dashes and movements.
Upgrading Speed increases this value by %1$s points.
gui.dmzrevamp.technique.effect.tooltip.h: Applies a self effect based on %1$s.
gui.dmzrevamp.technique.effect.tooltip.d: Scales with your current Melee DMG.
